**DE analysis against 2 controls**

```{r}
## LOAD LIBRARIES
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(UpSetR)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
```



```{r}
## DATA PROCESSING

# read in data
counts_matrix <- read.csv("~/Desktop/OVOL1_proj/hit-counts/raw_counts.csv")

# remove Gene ID column
counts_matrix$ID <- NULL

# summing gene counts of duplicated gene name
counts_matrix <- counts_matrix %>%
  group_by(Gene.name) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  ungroup()

# remove first row without genes
counts_matrix <- counts_matrix[-1, ]

# Set the unique gene names as row names
counts_matrix <- counts_matrix %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Gene.name") %>%
  as.matrix()

#renaming sample to maintain consistencies
counts_matrix <- as.data.frame(counts_matrix) %>% rename(
  K5.rtTA.1 = K5.1,
  K5.rtTA.2 = K5.2,
  K5.rtTA.3 = K5.3,
  K5.OVOL1.1 = K5Ovol1.1,
  K5.OVOL1.2 = K5Ovol1.2,
  K5.OVOL1.3 = K5Ovol1.3,
)


# make metadata
# Build manually matching your exact column order
col_data <- data.frame(
  row.names = c("K5.rtTA.3", "K5.rtTA.2", "K5.rtTA.1", 
                "K5.OVOL1.3", "K5.OVOL1.2", "K5.OVOL1.1", 
                "WT.3", "WT.2", "WT.1"),
  Group = factor(c("K5.rtTA", "K5.rtTA", "K5.rtTA", 
                   "K5.OVOL1", "K5.OVOL1", "K5.OVOL1", 
                   "WT", "WT", "WT"))
)

# Set 'WT' as the reference baseline group
col_data$Group <- relevel(col_data$Group, ref = "WT")


# Ensure Group is a factor with WT as the reference level
col_data$Group <- factor(col_data$Group, levels = c("WT", "K5.rtTA", "K5.OVOL1"))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_matrix,
  colData = col_data,
  design = ~ Group
)

# Filter low count genes across samples
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep, ]

# Run main DESeq analysis
dds <- DESeq(dds)

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Extract the 3 Specific Pairwise Contrasts
# ==============================================================================
# 1. K5Ovol1 vs K5 (Target vs Control 1)
res_Ovol1_vs_K5 <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group", "K5.OVOL1", "K5.rtTA"))

# 2. K5Ovol1 vs WT (Target vs Control 2)
res_Ovol1_vs_WT <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group", "K5.OVOL1", "WT"))

# 3. K5 vs WT (Control Baseline Check)
res_K5_vs_WT    <- results(dds, contrast = c("Group", "K5.rtTA", "WT"))

# Convert results to tidy data frames
df_Ovol1_vs_K5 <- as.data.frame(res_Ovol1_vs_K5) %>% rownames_to_column("Gene")
df_Ovol1_vs_WT <- as.data.frame(res_Ovol1_vs_WT) %>% rownames_to_column("Gene")
df_K5_vs_WT    <- as.data.frame(res_K5_vs_WT)    %>% rownames_to_column("Gene")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Intersection Filtering Logic
# ==============================================================================
# Set statistical significance thresholds
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff  <- 1

# 1. Genes DE in K5Ovol1 vs K5
de_Ovol1_vs_K5 <- df_Ovol1_vs_K5 %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < padj_cutoff & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff) %>%
  pull(Gene)

# 2. Genes DE in K5Ovol1 vs WT
de_Ovol1_vs_WT <- df_Ovol1_vs_WT %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < padj_cutoff & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff) %>%
  pull(Gene)


# 3. Genes NOT DE in K5 vs WT (Control Baseline Check)
# We consider a gene "Not DE" if its adjusted p-value is >= 0.05 (or NA) or have lfc < 1
not_de_K5_vs_WT <- df_K5_vs_WT %>%
  filter(is.na(padj) | padj >= padj_cutoff | abs(log2FoldChange) < lfc_cutoff) %>%
  pull(Gene)

de_K5_vs_WT <- df_K5_vs_WT %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < padj_cutoff & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff) %>%
  pull(Gene)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Final Intersection & Output Table
# ==============================================================================
# Find genes present in BOTH target contrasts AND absent/unchanged in control baseline
target_degs <- intersect(intersect(de_Ovol1_vs_K5, de_Ovol1_vs_WT), not_de_K5_vs_WT)

cat("Number of true Ovol1-induced DEGs:", length(target_degs), "\n")

# Combine detailed stats for these specific genes into a single master summary table
final_deg_table <- df_Ovol1_vs_K5 %>%
  filter(Gene %in% target_degs) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, log2FC_vs_K5 = log2FoldChange, padj_vs_K5 = padj) %>%
  inner_join(
    df_Ovol1_vs_WT %>% dplyr::select(Gene, log2FC_vs_WT = log2FoldChange, padj_vs_WT = padj),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    df_K5_vs_WT %>% dplyr::select(Gene, log2FC_K5_vs_WT = log2FoldChange, padj_K5_vs_WT = padj),
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  arrange(padj_vs_K5)

# Save to CSV
write.csv(final_deg_table, "~/Desktop/OVOL1_proj/Ovol1_Specific_DEGs_TwoControl_Filtered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
listInput <- list(K5.rtTA_vs_WT = de_K5_vs_WT, 
                  K5.OVOL1_vs_K5.rtTA = de_Ovol1_vs_K5, 
                  K5.OVOL1_vs_WT = de_Ovol1_vs_WT)
  
upset(fromList(listInput), order.by = "freq")
```
Cluster Profiler Pathway enrichment
```{r}
# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
gene_ids <- bitr(
  final_deg_table$Gene, 
  fromType = "SYMBOL", 
  toType   = "ENTREZID", 
  OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db
)

# Vector of Entrez IDs
entrez_vec <- gene_ids$ENTREZID

# Run GO Enrichment for Biological Processes (BP)
ego_bp <- enrichGO(
  gene          = entrez_vec,
  OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
  ont           = "BP",                # "BP" for Biological Process
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",                # Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.10,
  readable      = TRUE                 # Converts Entrez IDs back to Gene Symbols in results
)

# View top enriched terms
head(ego_bp)

p_dot <- dotplot(ego_bp, showCategory = 15, title = "GO Biological Processes")
print(p_dot)

# Run KEGG Enrichment (mmu = Mus musculus)
kegg_res <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = entrez_vec,
  organism     = "mmu",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)

# Convert Entrez IDs back to symbols in the KEGG object for readability
kegg_res <- setReadable(kegg_res, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

# View top KEGG pathways
head(kegg_res)

p_dot <- dotplot(kegg_res, showCategory = 15, title = "KEGG")
print(p_dot)
```


GO enrichment volcano plot & heat map (df_Ovol1_vs_K5)
```{r}
# 1. Prepare your input dataset
# Assume 'df_Ovol1_vs_K5' contains all genes with 'log2FoldChange' and 'padj'
# Assume 'pathway_genes' is a vector of gene symbols mapped to your GO/KEGG terms of interest 
# Example: pathway_genes <- c("Krt7", "Krt16", "Krt75", "Krt78", "Krt80", "Klf4", "Alox12b", "Aloxe3", "Pkp3", "Itga3", "Ovol1")
ego_bp <- as.data.frame(ego_bp)

pathway_gene_table <- ego_bp %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Description, p.adjust, geneID) %>%
  separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
  rename(Gene = geneID, Pathway = Description)
```


```{r}
target_pathway <- c("wound healing")

pathway_genes <- as.data.frame(ego_bp) %>%
  filter(Description == target_pathway, ignore.case = TRUE) %>%
  separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
  pull(geneID) %>%
  unique()

plot_df <- df_Ovol1_vs_WT %>%
  mutate(
    # Set significance status
    Significance = case_when(
      Gene %in% pathway_genes ~ "Pathway Gene",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange >= 0.585 ~ "Up-regulated",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange <= -0.585 ~ "Down-regulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    # Create -log10 p-adj column (cap extreme values for better plotting)
    negLogP = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-50))
  )

# 2. Build Volcano Plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = negLogP)) +
  # Background non-pathway points
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, Significance != "Pathway Gene"),
             aes(color = Significance), alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  # Highlight Pathway Genes on top
  geom_point(data = filter(plot_df, Significance == "Pathway Gene"),
             color = "#E41A1C", size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Add text labels for pathway genes
  geom_text_repel(
    data = filter(plot_df, Significance == "Pathway Gene"),
    aes(label = Gene),
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = 30
  ) +
  # Cutoff lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.585, 0.585), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  # Color palette
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Down-regulated" = "#377EB8",
    "Up-regulated"   = "#4DAF4A",
    "Not Significant"= "gray70"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: Ovol1-Induced Response",
    subtitle = "Highlighted genes belong to key enriched pathway - Wound Healing",
    x = expression(log[2] ~ "Fold Change (K5.OVOL1 vs WT)"),
    y = expression(-log[10] ~ "(" * italic(p)[adj] * ")"),
    color = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(volcano_plot)
```
